import json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
source=Path.cwd();review=source/'docs/DevDocs/assets/20o-b2-a6/self-review-20261107'
proxy=subprocess.check_output(['cmd','/c','git','config','--get','http.proxy'],text=True).strip();environment=os.environ.copy();environment.update(HTTP_PROXY=proxy,HTTPS_PROXY=proxy)
run=42340653748
for _ in range(50):
    p=subprocess.run(['gh','api',f'repos/Programming-Language-Xiao/Xiao/actions/runs/{run}'],env=environment,capture_output=True,timeout=55)
    if p.returncode:
        print('CI查询暂不可用，将保留实际最终响应',flush=True)
    else:
        value=json.loads(p.stdout)
        assert value['head_sha']=='bbf9feaa76e1fd5083bf7924a363a31baf4c69a9'
        if value['status']=='completed':
            argv=[sys.executable,'-X','utf8','docs/DevDocs/assets/20o-b2-a6/entry-20261107/collect-ci.py','--run',str(run),'--git-proxy','--output',str(review/'ci')]
            result=subprocess.run(argv,env=environment)
            assert result.returncode==0
            print(json.dumps({'run_id':run,'conclusion':value['conclusion'],'code_commit':value['head_sha']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
            raise SystemExit(0 if value['conclusion']=='success' else 1)
    time.sleep(30)
raise SystemExit('CI观察窗口耗尽，尚未确认')
